vn.titel: Keep your promises. Hold the coalition.
vn.intro: The decision remains binding. Review its terms, reactions to the compromise and your partners’ current support.
vn.auftrag: {bip}% of GDP charged upon approval. Ready from {ab}; in force until {bis}.
vn.auftragFehlt: The current mandate cannot be matched to this decision. Its promises are therefore not shown as fulfilled.
vn.abweichung: The current allocation or mandate differs from the binding decision. Review supply policy; the historical promise remains on record.
vn.zusage.sozial: Social compensation runs automatically with monthly accounting while the mandate is active. It supports households without creating additional goods.
vn.zusage.haushalt: The reduced budget has already been charged. Support ends sooner; an extension requires a new decision.
vn.zusage.kontrolle: The monthly report discloses results. Supporters and the opposition react more strongly to recovery or shortages.
vn.zusage.zivil: Civilian priority starts upon approval, including the preparation period. Maintain this allocation until the end; fronts bear the cost when supplies are scarce.
vn.zusage.einsatz: Front-line priority starts upon approval, including the preparation period. Maintain this allocation until the end; civilians bear the cost when supplies are scarce.
vn.ohneKlauseln: The basic mandate applies; no additional parliamentary clauses were agreed.
vn.monat: Last documented active month for this mandate: {monat} · civilian needs covered: {n}%.
vn.nochKeinBericht: No active monthly report can yet be attributed to this specific mandate.
vn.monatsregel: Below 90% civilian coverage, supporting factions lose confidence and the opposition demands accountability. From 90%, an improvement of more than two percentage points earns support. Other political developments also affect the coalition.
vn.doppelt: The agreed parliamentary scrutiny doubles the monthly reaction.
vn.keinStreit: This vote triggered no negative faction reaction. The current coalition position is shown below.
vn.gescheitert: The joint initiative failed. The coalition partner loses confidence in cooperation.
vn.gegensatz: The demand was “{forderung}”. The conflicting term “{statt}” was adopted.
vn.offeneForderung: The demand for “{forderung}” remained unmet in the adopted package.
vn.alteReaktion: No exact faction-reaction booking was saved for this older decision.
vn.ausgeschieden: This party is no longer in the governing coalition. Talks alone do not restore the alliance.
vn.pruefung: Next regular monthly check: {datum}. If an active party leader’s loyalty is below {grenze}, their party leaves the coalition. Other monthly effects are booked before that check.
vn.keinePartner: No other parties are currently in the governing coalition. Negotiate new cooperation in parliament.
vn.sitzeReichen: A numerical seat majority remains. This does not guarantee support for individual bills.
vn.sitzeFehlen: That leaves a shortfall of {n} seats for a majority. Votes on individual bills may differ.
vn.weitereZusagen: {n} other outstanding promises to this partner
vn.aktion.fraktion.text: Raises willingness to cooperate and the active party leadership’s loyalty. Faction talks are possible every 30 days.
vn.aktion.vertrauen.text: A personal conversation with the least loyal party leader. Effects depend on personality and resentment; 21 days between talks, at most four personal meetings in 30 days.
vn.aktion.rueckendeckung.text: Supports the party leader and close allies, costs up to 0.1 government trust and increases ambition. Shares the cooldown with other personal conversations.
vn.danach: Afterwards: {n} loyalty for the weakest leader
vn.bleibtAkut: Still below the break threshold. This action alone is insufficient.
vn.knappGerettet: Above the immediate threshold, but with little room for further losses.
vn.mehrPuffer: More room above the break threshold. Future political losses remain possible.
vn.alleFolgen: Exact effects on people and trust
vn.nebenfolgen: For the conversation partner: resentment {groll}, ambition {ehrgeiz}. Government trust: {vertrauen}.
vn.keinVorsitz: Without an assigned active leader, personal loyalty cannot support a concrete break forecast.
vn.dauerhaft: Talks stabilise support. Lasting cooperation depends on kept promises and supply results; the adopted terms remain binding.
vn.nichtMoeglich: This stabilisation action is not currently available.
vn.veraltet: Conditions or the negotiating position changed. Nothing was booked; review the updated options.
vn.gebucht: Talks with {partei} completed; {pk} PC spent. Actual effects appear in the record below the coalition position.
vn.termine: All {n} personal meetings for the last 30 days have been used.
vn.hoheLoyalitaet: Loyalty is already at least 90; another trust conversation adds nothing.
vn.keinAnlass: There is currently no reason to offer public backing.
vn.pause: New talks are blocked by overload until {datum}.
vn.kapitalGrenze: The overdraft limit of {n} PC is exhausted.
vn.aufPump: On credit: {n} PC afterwards. If the balance remains negative after the monthly credit, it costs up to 0.6 legitimacy and 0.25 government trust per month.
vn.erschoepfung: {n} attention afterwards. Below 20, daily strain increases.
vn.lagerGeaendert: Your coalition has changed since the vote
vn.ehemaligePartner: These parties were coalition members at the vote but are no longer members today: {parteien}. This alone does not establish why they left.
vn.mehrheitHeute: A numerical seat majority still exists today. This does not guarantee support for individual bills.
vn.lueckeHeute: Today the government is {n} seats short of the 301-seat majority; temporary backing and support on individual issues are counted separately.
vn.neuesBuendnis: Negotiate a new alliance or temporary backing with the factions. Supply commitments already adopted remain binding despite the change in coalition.
